name: Requirements
criterion: All release-assigned requirements meet source acceptance and recovery behaviours.

name: Contracts
criterion: Closed schemas, generated types, compatibility and policy coverage pass.

name: Database
criterion: Fresh install, upgrade, checksums, real-role isolation and concurrent transactions pass.

name: Identity and access
criterion: Federation, recovery, grant issuance, revocation, purpose and independence pass.

name: Measurement
criterion: Golden corpus, source lineage and official report reconciliation pass.

name: Web
criterion: Complete workflows, browser matrix, keyboard, screen reader and responsive checks pass.

name: Android
criterion: Qualified device matrix proves expiry, encryption, account isolation and durable sync.

name: Integration
criterion: Provider scope, checkpoint, credential rotation, retry and replay tests pass.

name: Performance
criterion: FSD peak, burst, soak and largest-tenant bounds pass with background work.

name: Recovery
criterion: RPO and RTO measured; deletion and identity restrictions survive restore.

name: Security
criterion: Independent assessment has no unresolved critical/high access or integrity failure without verified mitigation.

name: AI
criterion: Released use cases pass grounding, correctness, privacy, injection, confirmation and budget evaluation.

name: Operations
criterion: Alerts, on-call route, runbooks, limits and support custody exercised.

name: Release
criterion: Artifact, schema, policy, fixture, SBOM and evidence manifest match the release candidate.
